title: Rita’s Rowdy Enchiladas
method: Toss chicken and sliced peppers with spices and oil; roast covered at 190°C for 25-30 mins, then shred chicken.
Sauté onion and garlic; add passata, oregano, chipotle paste; simmer 10 mins. Add beans and lime juice.
Mix 1/3 sauce and half mozzarella with chicken.
Roll chicken mixture in tortillas, pack in baking dish, top with remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake 20-25 mins until browned and bubbling. Top with chopped coriander.
